description: Unified building (cadaster) schema: every source in pycensus.cadaster returns one row per building with these columns (EPSG:4326 geometry: footprint polygon, or a point where the source has only points). Unknown values are null, never invented.

fields.name: building_id
fields.definition: Source identifier of the building (unique within source).

fields.name: footprint_m2
fields.definition: Ground footprint area (true area, not projected).

fields.name: floors_above
fields.definition: Floors above ground (for buildings made of parts: footprint-weighted mean of the parts).

fields.name: built_area_m2
fields.definition: Gross floor area above ground: the source's official floor area when it has one, else sum over parts of part footprint x floors, else footprint x height / floor_height_m (see built_area_method).

fields.name: use_class
fields.definition: Unified main use (see each source schema's use_map).

fields.name: use_original
fields.definition: The source's own use / occupancy code.

fields.name: units
fields.definition: Number of building units (dwellings + premises) where the source counts them.

fields.name: population_night
fields.definition: Residents estimated by the source for the building (night-time), if the source has it.

fields.name: population_day
fields.definition: People in the building during the day, if the source has it.

fields.name: year_built
fields.definition: Year of construction (start of lifespan where that is what the source records).
